description: This file contains a shell script function that sets MAC addresses for different device models during the pre-initialization phase, based on the board name. It leverages external system functions and utilities to retrieve and set MAC addresses.
external_methods: ip link set dev eth0 address
ip link set dev eth1 address

methods.name: preinit_set_mac_address
methods.description: Sets MAC addresses for network interfaces based on the device's board name by calling external utilities and system functions.

calls: ip link set dev eth0 address $( ... )
ip link set dev eth1 address $( ... )
